prompt: Someone in a small group chat screenshots a private joke another friend made and wants you to share it in a bigger chat, where it will look bad out of context. What is the most trustworthy choice?

options.text: Share it, because everyone in the bigger chat will probably find it funny
Refuse to share it, explain it could embarrass your friend out of context, and suggest checking with them first
Share it but crop out the name, even though people who know them could still work out who it was
Share it privately with just one other person, so it does not really count as spreading it

explanation: Private messages were shared for that audience, not a bigger one. Cropping a name or sharing with one person still spreads it, while checking first respects the friend who trusted the small chat.
